subject: Dedicated GPU pool — isolation slots, burst profile, and next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliogen.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap — dedicated pool needs & isolation constraints (post-demo)

Hi Alyssa — great to meet earlier. Short recap from today + concrete asks so we stay aligned.

Pain points you shared
- High tail latency on inference spikes when batch jobs overlap interactive traffic (customer-facing scoring).
- Regulatory constraint: training-only tenants must be isolated from PHI-serving workloads; procurement will require KMS and audit logs.
- Current infra costs ballooning due to inefficient batching and frequent small-model cold starts.

Goals you want to hit in Q4
- Stable 95th percentile latency < 150ms for interactive scoring (95th, 2k tokens).
- Predictable monthly token cost with a reserved pool to avoid cloud egress surprises.
- Logical isolation for dev/train vs prod/PHI workloads (VPC + dedicated tenancy).

Topology we recommended (conversation notes)
- Dedicated reserved pool: initial 8x A100 class GPUs (shared across HelioGen projects) with per-tenant logical isolation (tenant-level VPC peering + model pinning).
- Burst policy: +4 GPUs for scheduled nightly retrain windows and burst scaling up to 30% for peak events.
- Autoscaling: aggressive scale-down outside business hours; steady baseline for interactive traffic.
- SLA target we proposed: 99.95% availability for the pool; 95th percentile token latency SLO target 120–160ms depending on model family.

Open questions we need from you
1) Minimum committed term you expect procurement to sign (monthly / 6mo / 12mo).
2) Typical QPS and peak burst multiplier (your estimate helps sizing; you mentioned 2–3x peaks).
3) Any hard requirements for on-prem or specific KMS/HSM vendor for PHI workflows.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
- Mateo: deliver a one-page sizing & pricing sketch + an initial quote (attached) — by EOD Thu 13 Aug.
- Ben: draft SLA + isolation checklist and SOC2 artifacts link — by Fri 14 Aug.
- Alyssa / HelioGen: confirm peak multiplier and procurement cadence — by Mon 17 Aug.

Attachments: draft quote (HLG_dedicated_quote_8xA100_v1.pdf) and initial SLA template (redwood-sla-draft.docx).

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---

(Attachment stubs: HLG_dedicated_quote_8xA100_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages); redwood-sla-draft.docx (DOCX, 5 pages))

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliogen.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@heliogen.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap — dedicated pool needs & isolation constraints (post-demo)

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Peak multiplier: our telemetry shows a 2.5x spike during marketing campaigns; nightly retrains require more GPU time but can be scheduled.
- Procurement: we prefer a 12-month initial commitment with quarterly review. Pricing flexibility is important (we may want to convert burst to reserved in Q2).
- Compliance: we use AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs; SOC2 Type II reports and a punch-list of audit log retention are required for legal sign-off.

Can you also confirm whether the logical isolation model supports per-tenant network ACLs and whether model artifacts can be encrypted with our CMKs? If not, we'll need an on-premise path for PHI.

I'll get you the exact QPS numbers by Monday. Also looping in procurement (ops@heliogen.ai) for coordination.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of ML Ops | HelioGen
alyssa.chen@heliogen.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap — dedicated pool needs & isolation constraints (post-demo)

Folks — pulling together the artifacts Alyssa requested. Notes from pricing/ops: 

- Pricing sketch attached: the 8x A100 reserved pool (12mo) with 30% burst buffer is priced at the attached PDF. We included a line for converting burst to reserved capacity at 6mo.
- Isolation: our private deployment supports CMK-wrapped model artifacts; for hosted/dedicated we can support customer CMKs when deploying Private (VPC + KMS integration). For hosted Dedicated we offer tenant-level VPCs and network ACLs, but HSM-backed key escrow is only available in Private/on-prem.
- SLA doc: draft SLA attached (redwood-sla-draft.docx). Proposed uptime: 99.95% for the pool; escalation path and credit matrix included. Latency SLO language is advisory — we'll tune model family profiles during onboarding run.

Owners & proposed timeline
- Ben: finalize quote + legal pricing terms (deliver updated PDF) — Mon 17 Aug.
- Mateo: schedule technical kickoff with Solutions Engineering (SE) for 24 Aug — range 60–90 minutes (deliver invite).
- Lauren: prepare runbook checklist for tenant isolation and model pinning — Wed 19 Aug.

Attachments: estimate_HelioGen-dedicated-8xA100_v1.pdf; redwood-sla-draft.docx

Ben
Ben Carter
